standard: Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) style error typology, configured for accessibility and localization review
source_note: Category names follow the published MQM dimensions; weights and pass thresholds are local policy configured for this Skill Tool.

categories.name: Mistranslation
categories.definition: Target does not convey the meaning of the source.

categories.name: Omission
categories.definition: Content present in the source is missing from the target.

categories.name: Addition
categories.definition: Target adds content not present in the source.

categories.name: Untranslated
categories.definition: Source text was left untranslated in the target.

categories.name: Untranslatable
categories.definition: Content cannot be translated as written and needs source change.

categories.name: Grammar
categories.definition: Morphology or syntax violates target-language rules.

categories.name: Spelling
categories.definition: Misspelling or invalid orthography.

categories.name: Punctuation
categories.definition: Punctuation does not follow target conventions.

categories.name: Terminology
categories.definition: Approved term not used, or a forbidden term was used.

categories.name: Inconsistency
categories.definition: Same concept rendered differently within the same deliverable.

categories.name: Style
categories.definition: Register, tone or voice deviates from the style guide.

categories.name: Plain language
categories.definition: Register is more complex than the audience requires.

categories.name: Locale convention
categories.definition: Date, number, currency, address or name format does not match the locale.

categories.name: Markup or placeholder
categories.definition: Tag, placeholder or variable was corrupted or dropped.

categories.name: Length
categories.definition: Target exceeds the available space or the expansion budget.

categories.name: Truncation
categories.definition: Visible text is clipped in the interface.

categories.name: Accessibility wording
categories.definition: Accessible name, error message or instruction does not meet the wording rules.

categories.name: Label in name
categories.definition: Translated accessible name no longer contains the visible label.

categories.name: Caption accuracy or sync
categories.definition: Caption text is inaccurate, unsynchronised or omits meaningful sound.

categories.name: Alternative text
categories.definition: Alt text is missing, non-descriptive or does not serve the image purpose.

categories.name: Bidirectional defect
categories.definition: Text direction, mirroring or bidi ordering is wrong.

categories.name: Other
categories.definition: Any other defect, described in the note.

pass_thresholds.note: Score = 100 - (penalty points per 1000 sampled words / 2). A single critical defect blocks release regardless of score.
